guidelines.title: App Completeness
guidelines.text: Apps must be complete and fully functional when submitted. Submissions should be final versions with all necessary metadata.

guidelines.title: User-Generated Content
guidelines.text: Apps with user-generated content must include content filtering, a mechanism to report offensive content, and the ability to block abusive users.

guidelines.title: App Completeness
guidelines.text: Submissions to App Review should be final versions with complete metadata. Do not include placeholder content, broken links, or test data.

guidelines.title: Accurate Metadata
guidelines.text: App descriptions, screenshots, and previews must accurately reflect the app's core experience. Do not include content that is not relevant.

guidelines.title: No Platform References
guidelines.text: Apps and metadata should not reference other mobile platforms (Android, Windows, etc.).

guidelines.title: Software Requirements
guidelines.text: Apps may only use public APIs. Use of private or undocumented APIs will result in rejection.

guidelines.title: Background Execution
guidelines.text: Multitasking apps may only use background services for their intended purposes: VoIP, audio playback, location, task completion, local notifications, etc.

guidelines.title: In-App Purchase
guidelines.text: Apps offering digital content or services must use in-app purchase. Apps may not use their own mechanisms to unlock features or functionality.

guidelines.title: Subscriptions
guidelines.text: Subscriptions must clearly disclose the price, payment frequency, and length of subscription terms. Auto-renewable subscriptions must provide a clear explanation of what the user gets.

guidelines.title: Unacceptable Business Model
guidelines.text: Apps that are primarily marketing materials, ads, or web clippings will be rejected.

guidelines.title: Design
guidelines.text: Apple places high value on well-designed apps. Apps should follow the Human Interface Guidelines and provide a high-quality user experience.

guidelines.title: Copycats
guidelines.text: Apps that duplicate another app (including Apple's built-in apps) may be removed. Bring unique value.

guidelines.title: Minimum Functionality
guidelines.text: Your app should include sufficient content and features so it functions as an app, not a repackaged website.

guidelines.title: Design Spam
guidelines.text: Apps that are duplicates of existing apps, or that provide minimal unique value, may be rejected.

guidelines.title: Data Collection and Storage
guidelines.text: Apps must comply with all applicable privacy laws. Apps that collect user data must have a privacy policy and must obtain user consent.

guidelines.title: Data Use and Sharing
guidelines.text: Apps must not use or transmit personal data without user consent. Data collected for one purpose may not be repurposed without consent.

guidelines.title: Privacy Policy Requirement
guidelines.text: All apps must include a link to their privacy policy in the App Store Connect metadata and within the app.

guidelines.title: Privacy Manifest
guidelines.text: Apps must include a privacy manifest (PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy) declaring their data collection practices and required reason APIs.

guidelines.title: Intellectual Property - General
guidelines.text: Don't use protected third-party material such as trademarks, copyrighted works, or patented ideas without permission.

guidelines.title: Sign in with Apple
guidelines.text: Apps that exclusively use a third-party login service must also offer Sign in with Apple as an equivalent option.

guidelines.title: Apple Pay
guidelines.text: Apps using Apple Pay must do so in accordance with Apple Pay guidelines and must not attempt to circumvent Apple Pay restrictions.

guidelines.title: App Tracking Transparency
guidelines.text: Apps must use the AppTrackingTransparency framework to request user permission before tracking. Use of IDFA requires ATT prompt.
